title: Directed differentiation of stomach tissue from mouse embryonic stem cells.
protocol: Add 0.1% w/v Gelatin solution to a 100 mm-culture dish.
Incubate the dish with Gelatin for 2 hours to overnight.
Harvest embryonic day 13.5 mouse embryos from pregnant female mice.
Wash the harvested embryos briefly with PBS.
Separate embryos from placenta using forceps.
Carefully remove the head, visceral tissues, and gonads from isolated embryos.
Wash the remaining tissue fragments with PBS at least twice.
Transfer the washed embryo fragments to a 50 mL centrifuge tube containing PBS.
Mince the embryo fragments into small pieces using scissors.
Centrifuge the tube at 1,000 rpm for 5 minutes after dissection.
Aspirate the supernatant and re-suspend the pellet in 0.25% w/v trypsin solution.
Incubate the suspension at 37 °C for 15 minutes.
Add 10 mL of MEF medium to the digested tissue and pipette vigorously.
Transfer the digestion mixture containing tissue fragments to a 100 µm Cell Strainer to remove debris.
Optional: If necessary, add DNase I solution to digest genomic DNA before passing through the strainer.
Collect the filtrate from the strainer.
Centrifuge the collected solution at 1,000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and re-suspend the pellet in fresh MEF medium.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 100-mm culture dish (1 embryo per dish).
Culture at 37°C with 5% CO₂ overnight.
Aspirate the medium and change it with fresh MEF medium the next day.
Passage to new gelatin-coated 150-mm culture dishes at a 1:4 dilution using 0.25w/v% trypsin digestion after 3-4 days of culture.
Culture and passage the MEF cells 2-3 times.
Incubate with fresh MEF medium and 70 μL of 2 mg/mL MMC solution (12.5 mL total) at 37°C with 5% CO₂ for 2.5 to 3 hours after the cells become confluent.
Wash out MMC solution with fresh PBS twice.
Digest MEF cells with 0.25% w/v trypsin at 37°C for 5 min.
Add fresh MEF medium to stop trypsin activity, harvest the MMC-treated MEF cells, and centrifuge at 1,000 rpm for 5 min.
Re-suspend in MEF medium and transfer the MMC-treated MEF cells to gelatin-coated 60-mm culture dish.
Culture the MMC-treated MEF cells overnight.
Optional: Re-suspend the cells in Cell Banker 1 after centrifugation of MMC-treated MEF cells.
Dispense 1 mL of Cell Banker 1 solution into a vial and transfer to -80°C for storage.
Incubate frozen stock at 37°C until half-thawed.
Transfer to 10 mL pre-warmed MEF medium in a 15 mL tube, centrifuge at 1,000 rpm for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant and re-suspend in MEF medium.
Transfer the resuspended cells to gelatin-coated culture dish.
Change with fresh MEF medium the next day.
Use MMC-treated MEF cells as feeder cells for ES cell culture immediately or store them for 2-3 days.
Prepare feeder cells by culturing MMC-treated MEF cells on a 60-mm dish before starting ES cell culture.
Prepare 10 mL of pre-warmed ES medium in a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Transfer frozen stock of E14 ES cells from -80°C and incubate at 37°C until half the solution has thawed.
Suspend the thawed cells in 10 mL of pre-warmed ES medium.
Pipette the suspension repeatedly to harvest any remaining ES cells on the vial bottom.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 1,000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the MEF medium from the feeder cells culture dish during centrifugation.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL of fresh ES medium by pipetting 7-10 times to dissociate it.
Transfer the resuspended ES cells onto the feeder cells and culture at 37°C with 5% CO2 overnight.
Aspirate old ES medium from the 60-mm dish the next day.
Change to fresh ES medium for continued culture at 37°C with 5% CO2 for another 2 days without changing the medium.
Change the medium after a 2-day culture of ES cells.
Culture ES cells at 37°C with 5% CO₂ for an additional day.
Prepare fresh feeder cells from frozen stock (See Procedure A) for the next ES cell passage.
After 1 day of feeder cell culture, change their medium to ES medium (NOT MEF medium).
Wash ES cells twice with PBS after a day's culture.
Add 500 μL of 0.25w/v% trypsin solution directly to the ES cells and incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
Add 5 mL fresh ES medium to stop digestion.
Repeat pipetting vigorously 7-10 times to dissociate small ES cell pellets into single cells.
Harvest only 50 μL of single ES cell suspension and transfer it to feeder cells containing ES medium.
Culture the transferred ES cells at 37°C with 5% CO₂ overnight.
Change to fresh ES medium after another day's culture.
Continue to culture ES cells at 37°C with 5% CO₂ for an additional 2 days without changing the medium.
Optional: Stop ES cells culture instead of going to next differentiation steps.
Wash ES cells with PBS twice.
Digest the ES cells with 0.25% w/v trypsin at 37°C for 5 min.
Add fresh ES medium to stop trypsin digestion, harvest the ES cells, and centrifuge at 1,000 rpm for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant and gently re-suspend the ES cells pellet in Stem Cell banker solution (Takara Bio).
Dispense the suspended cells into vials and transfer them to -80°C.
Prepare a gelatin-coated 100-mm dish.
After 2 days of culture, wash with fresh PBS twice.
Add 0.25% w/v trypsin solution and incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
Add 5 mL fresh EB medium to stop trypsin activity, and pipette vigorously 7-10 times to dissociate ES cells.
Transfer the ES cell suspension to fresh 10 mL EB medium in a 15 mL tube and centrifuge at 1,000 rpm for 5 min.
After centrifugation, aspirate supernatant and add 5 mL EB medium to dissolve ES cells pellet to single cell.
Transfer the ES cell solution to the gelatin-coated 100-mm dish and incubate at 37°C for 45 min.
DO NOT add ES medium when harvesting ES cells.
Incubate for 45 minutes and harvest supernatant containing only ES cells.
Transfer harvested supernatant to a 15 mL tube and centrifuge at 1,000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant from the pellet and re-suspend the pellet in fresh EB medium.
Count the number of cells and estimate the volume of suspension containing 5.0 x 10^4 ES cells.
Transfer a suspension containing 5 x 10^4 ES cells to 10 mL EB medium in a reservoir.
Dispense 100 μL of ES cell suspension into each ultra-low attachment well, ensuring each well contains approximately 500 ES cells.
Culture the wells at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 6 days without changing the medium.
Check EB formation by microscopy on day 1.
Prepare a geratin-coated 6 well plate.
Harvest EBs from each 96 well using a 200 μL ultra-low attachment filter chip.
Transfer 10 harvested EBs to a 15 mL tube containing 5 mL of fresh KSR medium.
Incubate the tube at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the medium gently and add another 5 mL of fresh KSR medium.
Gently rock the tube to wash out remaining EB medium from EBs.
Incubate the tube again at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the medium, add 2 mL of DS medium, and re-suspend the EBs.
Transfer the DS medium containing EBs to a geratin-coated 6 well dish.
Culture the EBs at 37°C with 5% CO₂ overnight.
Confirm that all EBs have attached on the dish the next day.
Change the medium to fresh DS medium.
Culture at 37°C with 5% CO₂ for 3 days.
Change the medium again to fresh DS medium after 3 days of culture.
Check for small dome structures differentiated from EBs after another 3 days of culture.
Change the medium once more to fresh DS medium after observing the dome structures.
Change with fresh KSR medium.
Culture at 37°C with 5% CO₂ for 3 days.
Change with fresh KSR medium.
Culture at 37°C with 5% CO₂ for 3 days.
Change with fresh KSR medium.
Culture at 37°C with 5% CO₂ for 3 days.
Prepare Matrigel solution.
Add the growth factor cocktail including 100 ng/mL FGF10, 100 ng/mL WNT3A, 100 ng/mL NOGGIN, and 250 ng/mL R-SPONDIN1 to 75-100 μL liquid Matrigel.
Mix the growth factor cocktail with liquid Matrigel by pipetting.
Store the Matrigel solution on ice until use.
Wash culture spheroids with PBS twice.
Transfer washed culture spheroids under microscopy.
Dissect and harvest spheroids carefully using autoclaved forceps.
Transfer harvested spheroids to 75-100 μL liquid Matrigel containing growth factors on ice.
Mix gently the Matrigel with spheroids.
Transfer these Matrigel-containing spheroids to a 12-well culture plate and form droplets.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min for polymerization of Matrigel.
Prepare FGF-based medium by adding growth factor cocktail as per the reagent setup instructions.
After incubation, add FGF-based medium gently on top of Matrigel droplet.
Culture at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 14 days and change the FGF medium every 4 days.
Wash e-ST (huge spheroids) with fresh PBS.
Add dispase solution to digest Matrigel at 37°C for 15 min.
After digestion, add 10 mL of FGF medium or PBS and gently wash three times.
Pick up e-ST using sterilized forceps.
Perform immunofluorescence staining for Muc5ac (Santacruz), Pgc (Abcam), and H+/K+ATPase (Abcam) expression.
